tagline: A dignified farewell, worthy of the love you shared

hero.title: A farewell as dignified as the love you shared
hero.subtitle: Private pet cremation, memorial ceremony, and grief support for families in Hanoi & Ho Chi Minh City. Open 24/7.

pickup.title: Home pickup
pickup.body: Dedicated vehicles, 24/7 dispatch, discrete attendants, absolute privacy.

private.title: Private cremation
private.body: One pet, one chamber. Every ash returned — never co-mingled.

ceremony.title: Farewell ceremony
ceremony.body: A private room for goodbye. HD livestream for family far from home.

urn.title: Handcrafted urns
urn.body: Bát Tràng ceramic urns, hand-engraved, with photo frame and certificate.

grief.title: Grief support
grief.body: Licensed counselors trained in pet bereavement — available 1:1.

memorial.title: Memorial garden
memorial.body: A quiet place to visit, an engraved headstone, fresh flowers year-round.

footer.address: 12 Ly Thuong Kiet, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi · 88 Nguyen Du, District 1, HCMC
